scope: Primary-source research for Ompra's curated developer, design and research integrations. Documentation verified; authenticated Ompra end-to-end connections were not tested by this research.
selectionPrinciples: Use official public MCP implementations when available; preserve each provider's account, runtime and plan requirements.
A hosted service is not MIT merely because its client wrapper is MIT. Ompra-authored metadata or adapters can have their own license.
Do not describe ChatGPT marketplace installation as installation into Ompra. An Ompra native package or adapter and a supported authentication flow are required.
Never copy a provider's OAuth client ID or embed client secrets from another application.
Pin distributable code or npm versions after verification; branch package.json versions below are observations, not proof of an npm release.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.authentication: A user-created GitHub personal access token works with generic HTTP MCP hosts. Remote OAuth requires the host to configure its own GitHub App or OAuth App; do not promise automatic Ompra OAuth without that registration.
entries.runtime: No extra local runtime for the hosted server. The official local alternative uses Docker or the released Go executable with stdio and GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.
entries.serviceLicense: GitHub service terms and user token permissions apply.
limitations: Available actions follow token permissions and organization policy.
Generic host OAuth is not interchangeable with GitHub Copilot's OAuth client.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.authentication: Hosted server supports browser OAuth with dynamic client registration. Documented alternative: Authorization: Bearer <SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN>, a scoped PAT. Add project_ref=<project-ref> when connecting a particular project.
entries.runtime: No extra local runtime for hosted HTTP. Local Supabase CLI exposes http://localhost:54321/mcp with a smaller tool subset.
entries.serviceLicense: Supabase service terms; project and organization permissions apply.
limitations: Read-only is deliberately enabled in this starter connection; writes require changing the explicit configuration.
Project scoping and available feature groups affect tools.
Current self-hosted handler documents newer protocol requirements; smoke-test the chosen hosted endpoint with OMP's protocol revision.

entries.name: Vercel
entries.authentication: OAuth. Official documentation says only reviewed and approved AI clients may connect.
entries.serviceLicense: Vercel hosted service; documentation names Public Beta Agreement and AI Product Terms.
limitations: Ompra is not verified as an approved client; show as requires provider approval, not installable and ready.
Documentation distinguishes unauthenticated documentation tools from authenticated account tools.

entries.name: Render
entries.authentication: User Render API key as Bearer header is documented for generic clients. Official integrations also support OAuth; Ompra must use its own authorized client configuration.
entries.runtime: Hosted HTTP needs no extra runtime. Optional local server is an executable or Docker container.
entries.serviceLicense: Render service terms and account resource permissions apply.
limitations: Confirm the target workspace before acting.
Service update tools may return Dashboard links instead of applying changes.
Database IP allowlists affect SQL queries; hosted MCP has no allowlistable addresses according to source README.

entries.name: Railway
entries.authentication: Remote OAuth or Railway CLI login reused by railway mcp.
entries.runtime: No local runtime for remote OAuth. CLI bridge requires Railway CLI >=5.44.0 and railway login.
entries.serviceLicense: Railway hosted service terms; deployed resources can incur account charges.
limitations: Do not install deprecated @railway/mcp-server; its repository was archived May 23, 2026 and the package is now a CLI compatibility shim.
CLI login state must stay in Ompra's portable profile if the CLI mode is offered.

entries.name: Figma
capabilities: Write native content to the canvas where supported
entries.authentication: Remote browser OAuth, with host approval: official introduction says only clients in Figma MCP Catalog may connect. Desktop connection is enabled in the signed-in Figma desktop app.
entries.runtime: Hosted mode has no local runtime. Desktop mode requires Figma desktop with its MCP server enabled.
entries.serviceLicense: Figma service; access and tool limits depend on seat and plan.
limitations: Ompra remote client is not verified or approved; do not label remote integration ready.
Desktop guide documents Other editors and can be a separately tested manual path.
Do not substitute a community PAT wrapper and claim it is Figma's official MCP server.

entries.name: Canva
capabilities: Export PDF, images, PPTX and video
entries.authentication: Canva must recognize the host's OAuth client. Self-serve Developer Portal path needs Client ID, client secret and registered redirects. Secretless CIMD clients apply for allowlisting; DCR remains backward-compatible but is deprecated.
entries.runtime: Hosted HTTP; no local runtime. Avoid embedding a shared confidential OAuth secret into a portable desktop executable.
entries.serviceLicense: Canva Developer Terms and MCP usage policy; no open-source server redistribution license established.
limitations: Ompra needs a supported host registration/authentication design before this can be a working consumer integration.
Plan-dependent features include resizing, autofill and brand kits/templates.
The local @canva/cli Dev MCP provides developer documentation and is a different product from design-account access.

entries.name: tldraw
capabilities: Create and edit diagrams and shapes
entries.authentication: The official production connection snippet declares no static credential. Actual service access and Ompra integration need separate verification.
entries.runtime: Hosted server; Ompra must implement MCP Apps iframe/widget lifecycle and callback bridge for the interactive canvas.
entries.upstreamCodeLicense: tldraw proprietary source-available license; production SDK use requires an applicable license agreement/key.
entries.serviceLicense: Do not bundle or rebrand the tldraw SDK as MIT. Linking to the provider-hosted MCP App is a separate integration path.
limitations: Text-only tools/list support is insufficient: current exec tool executes through the widget callback bridge.
Do not claim a usable embedded canvas until MCP Apps support is implemented and tested.
The March launch blog describes three shape tools; current source README documents search/exec plus widget-only callbacks, so use current tools/list.

entries.name: Firecrawl
capabilities: Authenticated advanced crawl, map and research tools
entries.authentication: Hosted keyless mode requires no account and exposes search/scrape/parse with limits. Full access uses browser OAuth or Authorization: Bearer <FIRECRAWL_API_KEY> on the standard endpoint.
entries.runtime: No extra local runtime for hosted HTTP; current local package requires Node >=22.
entries.serviceLicense: Firecrawl cloud service terms/credits; wrapper MIT does not relicense the cloud service or Firecrawl core.
limitations: Keyless daily limits and restricted tool surface; do not advertise crawl/map/agent as keyless.
Hosted MCP metadata/code can change independently; inspect tools/list on connection.

entries.name: Exa
entries.authentication: Hosted keyless search/fetch has free rate limits. OAuth uses ?login; non-OAuth clients may send x-api-key: <EXA_API_KEY>.
entries.runtime: No extra local runtime for hosted HTTP; local npm package requires Node >=20.
entries.serviceLicense: Exa service terms and account credits apply.
limitations: agent_run requires OAuth or an API key.
An explicit tools URL parameter replaces defaults; include all desired tools.
The ChatGPT/Codex directory plugin combines MCP and skills but is not directly an Ompra package.

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.authentication: No service account or API key. Uses the coding agent's existing model and tools.
entries.runtime: Skills plus a small Pi bootstrap extension. Git for repository acquisition; no hosted MCP service.
limitations: Current upstream main contains Pi package integration, but Pi and OMP extension/package interfaces must be checked before calling it compatible.
OMP wrapper can carry the upstream skills with retained MIT notices and an adapted bootstrap; avoid copying unsupported Claude/Codex hooks wholesale.
Upstream observes optional subagent and task-list companion packages; skill text alone does not implement those capabilities.

entries.name: Playwright
entries.authentication: No service account or API key for local browser automation. Website login is separate user browser state.
entries.runtime: Node >=18, npm/npx and a supported browser installation; browser binaries/cache must be handled separately from the portable EXE.
limitations: The official latest command is a documentation reference; the curated manifest should pin a verified published version.
Use isolated portable browser data; do not attach a user's existing browser profile by default.
A browser automation MCP is not a remote website search engine.

entries.name: Context7
capabilities: Retrieve current version-specific documentation and code examples
entries.authentication: Official MCP README documents keyless remote basic usage. Optional Authorization: Bearer <CONTEXT7_API_KEY> raises limits and enables account features.
entries.runtime: No extra local runtime for hosted HTTP; current package.json requires Node >=20.18.1 for local stdio.
entries.serviceLicense: Context7 hosted service terms and API limits; retrieved libraries retain their own documentation licenses.
limitations: This retrieves documentation, not arbitrary web search or guaranteed full coverage of every library.
Do not reuse old CONTEXT7_API_KEY header snippets: current README uses Authorization: Bearer for HTTP.
